description: Evaluate stairway geometry and life safety against SANS 10400-M standards (riser max 200 mm, going min 250 mm, 2R + G formula 570-650 mm, headroom min 2,100 mm).

baluster_gap_mm.description: Maximum clear gap between vertical balusters in millimetres (must not exceed 100 mm).

balustrade_height_mm.description: Height of balustrade in millimetres (min. 1,000 mm on landings, 850 mm on flights).

going_mm.description: Stair tread horizontal going in millimetres excluding nosing (must not be less than 250 mm).

headroom_mm.description: Vertical headroom clearance in millimetres measured vertically from the nosing pitch line (must be min. 2,100 mm).

riser_mm.description: Stair riser vertical height in millimetres (must not exceed 200 mm).

name: calculate_stair_compliance
